# SMEsAgent AI IDE

> Autonomous AI-Powered IDE & Sandboxed MicroVM Coding Engine

SMEsAgent is a next-generation AI IDE that enables developers and AI builders to generate, refactor, execute, and deploy full-stack web applications. Built on multi-modal LLM streaming, Firecracker MicroVM execution sandboxes, and automated deployment pipelines.

---

## Technical Overview

- **Core Stack**: React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Monaco Editor
- **Backend Infrastructure**: Node.js, Express, Supabase PostgreSQL, Redis
- **AI Streaming Engine**: Server-Sent Events (SSE) agent loop supporting Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Gemini 1.5 Pro
- **Sandboxing**: Isolated Firecracker MicroVMs with hot-module replacement and AST safeguard enforcement
- **Edge Deployment**: One-click Vercel REST API v13 deployment integration
- **Version Control**: Programmatic GitHub repository export via Octokit REST API

---

## Core API Reference

### 1. AI Agent Stream
`POST /api/v1/ai/agent-stream`
- Streams real-time code generation, tool calls, and AST file tree mutations via SSE.
- Supports multi-modal image attachments (wireframes, screenshots, visual assets).

### 2. Vercel Deployment
`POST /api/v1/deploy/:projectId`
- Fetches the latest code revision from Supabase (`revisions` table).
- Bundles Vite/React project files and deploys to Vercel production edge URLs.

### 3. GitHub Export
`POST /api/v1/github/export/:projectId`
- Accepts `{ githubToken, repoName, isPrivate }`.
- Programmatically creates a repository on the user's GitHub account and commits all sandboxed project files.

### 4. Billing & Quota Enforcement
`POST /api/v1/billing/webhook`
- Handles Stripe subscription events (`checkout.session.completed`, `customer.subscription.updated`, `customer.subscription.deleted`).
- Enforces monthly token and generation quotas across Free and Pro tiers.

---

## Page Route Map

- `/` — Public marketing & product landing page
- `/auth` — Supabase authentication screen (OAuth & Email/Password)
- `/dashboard` — User workspace command center
- `/editor/:projectId` — Interactive AI IDE workspace with Monaco code editor, live MicroVM preview, and agent chat panel
- `/billing` — Subscription plan management and usage quota metrics
